intro.title: How to choose a thought leadership agency
intro.content:
Plenty of thought leadership agencies do good work. The question is fit. A partner that is right for an enterprise SaaS company is often wrong for a commerce brand, because the two markets speak different languages and cite different numbers. Five things separate the options:

  • Industry fit. Does the agency know your market, or will you spend the first month teaching them the difference between Shopify and Magento?
  • Human or generated. Ask who writes the draft. Some agencies now lean on AI workflows, which shows up in content that reads like filler.
  • Research capability. Can they design original research and run a survey, or only write up what you hand them?
  • Format range. Whitepapers, reports, case studies, and sales enablement are different crafts.
  • Sales connection. The best thought leadership content gives your sales team something to send that closes.

items.title: Content Cucumber
items.content:
Content Cucumber is built for the commerce ecosystem. 40+ human writers, 30+ years in the industry, and deep knowledge of the platforms and SaaS tools your buyers use. Where the other agencies serve generic B2B, Content Cucumber writes thought leadership content that cites the platforms, metrics, and buyers a commerce or SaaS-platform brand sells into.

Every piece is written by a real person, researched and edited by people, with AI kept to the supporting layer. The flywheel turns one interview into a month of assets, and the Talk Commerce podcast (500+ episodes) is a built-in interview and distribution engine. It fits commerce brands, SaaS platforms serving commerce, and agencies that want a white-label content partner who already knows the space.

items.title: Animalz
items.content:
Animalz is a content marketing and SEO agency for leading B2B SaaS brands, known for premium editorial long-form and, more recently, an Answer Engine Optimization practice. Clients have included Google, Amazon, Zendesk, and Slack, and the model combines proprietary research, playbooks, and AI workflows.

It fits growth-stage and enterprise SaaS companies that want high-end editorial and durable organic growth. The consideration for a commerce brand is that Animalz is built for generic SaaS rather than the commerce ecosystem, and industry commentary notes the agency has contracted while it pivots toward AEO.

items.title: Column Five
items.content:
Column Five is a visual storytelling and content marketing agency known for data visualization, infographics, annual reports, and design-driven brand content. The strength is turning complex data into visual narratives.

It fits brands that need design-heavy assets and have the budget for premium, campaign-based creative. The consideration is that the work is visual-first and project-based, which is a different fit than a steady program of written whitepapers and case studies.

items.title: Contently
items.best_for: Content at scale through a platform
items.content:
Contently pairs a content platform with a large freelance network and named thought leadership services. The model is built for volume and workflow, giving in-house teams a way to run a lot of long-form content with talent management on top.

It fits teams that need a scaled content operation with platform support. The consideration is that a marketplace-and-platform model is less bespoke than a dedicated team that learns your brand and market over time.

items.title: Uplift Content
items.content:
Uplift Content is a specialized B2B SaaS content agency whose flagship is customer case studies, along with ebooks and whitepapers. The process is interview-heavy and built to turn customer stories into sales-enabling assets.

It fits SaaS teams that want case studies produced end to end. The consideration is a narrow SaaS case-study niche with limited design and SEO scope, and a slower pace at high volume.

items.title: iResearch Services
items.content:
iResearch Services is a research-driven thought leadership agency known for data-backed campaigns and work with large enterprises. The emphasis is on original research and insight-led narratives at scale.

It fits enterprises that want a big research program behind their thought leadership. The consideration is enterprise scale and pricing, which can be more than a growth-stage commerce brand needs.

items.title: Make Honey
items.content:
Make Honey positions as a B2B whitepaper and original-research agency for technology brands, producing whitepapers with research, thought leadership strategy, and expert copywriting for senior buyers.

It fits technology brands that want whitepaper-led thought leadership. The consideration for a commerce brand is the general tech focus rather than commerce-specific depth.

items.answer: Animalz is built for enterprise SaaS. For a commerce or SaaS-platform brand, Content Cucumber is the closer fit, with commerce-industry depth and fully human-written content rather than AI workflows.

items.question: Are these agencies' content written by humans or AI?
